welcome.title: Welcome to Crypto Portfolio Manager
welcome.subtitle: Onboarding & Quick Start Guide
welcome.intro: Monitor trading performance, balances, active positions, funding fees, order history, and transaction logs across Bitget, Bybit, and OKX in one unified terminal.
welcome.privacyWarning: Your API credentials are saved strictly in your browser's localStorage using zero-trust encryption. Communication with the exchanges occurs directly from your browser. Always use READ-ONLY API keys.
welcome.feature0Desc: Create read-only API keys on your exchanges, or try the platform without credentials by toggling Simulation Mode under Settings.
welcome.feature1Desc: Track unified balances, positions, margin ratios, and view advanced analytics like Funding Fees, Order Reports, and PnL charts.
welcome.feature2Desc: Connect exchanges via the API Keys page. All credentials are encrypted with your master passphrase locally in the browser.
welcome.feature3Desc: Click the Eye Icon in the header to toggle Privacy Mode. This hides balance, size, and PnL values for safe public sharing or streaming.
welcome.feature4Desc: Histories and currency rates operate on a background cache. Customize update intervals under the Settings page.
welcome.feature5Desc: Install the application as a Progressive Web App (PWA) on your mobile or desktop device for a native experience.
welcome.disclaimerDesc: This application unifies balances from various exchanges in one place. As each exchange has specific calculation methods, data presented may differ slightly from the official exchange site.

dashboard.subtitle: Capital protection in inverse (Coin-M) contracts: shorts lock USD at entry; longs and uncovered balance stay exposed.
dashboard.classicPnlTooltip: Displays traditional accounting Unrealized PnL and ROI relative to wallet balance.
dashboard.hedgeConceptTooltip: Hedge Concept: Frame PnL as Opportunity Cost (uncaptured upside when market rises) or Asset Accumulation (gaining coin units when market drops).

totalProtectedTooltip.title: Total Protected Capital — capital protected against cryptocurrency market volatility.
totalProtectedTooltip.hedgeDesc: • Hedge: USD value locked at entry price by inverse shorts (Coin-M). Does not float with the asset price.
totalProtectedTooltip.stablecoinsDesc: • Stablecoins: Liquid balance held in USD-pegged tokens (USDT, USDC, etc.) protecting dollar purchasing power.

totalEquityTooltip.title: Total portfolio capital — the entire equity the hedge protects. The hedge covers the whole account, not just the coins holding inverse positions.
totalEquityTooltip.formula: Total Equity = Σ USD value of every balance (all exchanges, all coins, cash and stablecoins included) — the same source as the 'Total Equity' card on the main Dashboard, so the two reconcile.
totalEquityTooltip.reference: This is the reference for Protected of Equity (Protected ÷ Equity) and Real Hedge Coverage ((Protected − Leveraged) ÷ Equity).

kpis.totalLeveragedTooltip: Sum of the notional (position value) of inverse LONGS. Longs in inverse contracts are leveraged exposure — they do not protect capital, they increase risk.

realHedgeCoverageTooltip.title: Net protection of the portfolio — protected capital minus leveraged exposure, relative to total equity. Only the protected leg counts: leveraged longs are NOT protected, they only add risk.
realHedgeCoverageTooltip.formula: Formula: (Total Protected − Total Leveraged) ÷ Total Equity × 100. The leveraged leg is subtracted because it is exposure without protection.
realHedgeCoverageTooltip.negativeNote: This can be negative: if you hold leveraged longs with no shorts protecting anything, nothing is shielded while leverage is still running — negative coverage means MORE risk, not less. Equal to Protected of Equity only when there are no leveraged longs.

protectedOfEquityTooltip.title: Share of the entire portfolio equity protected by inverse shorts — how much of the whole account's capital is shielded from asset variation.
protectedOfEquityTooltip.formula: Formula: Total Protected ÷ Total Equity × 100. Same denominator as the 'Hedge Mode (Inverse)' indicator on the main Dashboard, so the two reconcile.
protectedOfEquityTooltip.difference: Difference vs Real Hedge Coverage: this card divides only by Total Equity; Real Hedge Coverage also subtracts the leveraged longs from the protected side, so it is always ≤ this card (and can go negative when leveraged exceeds protected). The leftover % here is the share of the whole account still exposed.

drawer.opportunityCostTooltip: In inverse hedges, short PnL drops as market rises above entry. This is not capital loss, but uncaptured upside on the USD-locked leg, while your exposed balance captured full market appreciation.
drawer.accumulatedAssetTooltip: In inverse hedges, short PnL increases as spot price falls below entry. The position accumulates extra coin units to maintain the exact USD protection target while the exposed balance depreciated in USD.
